WITH CLIENT_AGE1 AS (
SELECT CLM.CLM_ID, 
CL.H_CAU_REQ_TO,
CL.H_ADD_TS AS STARTDT,
NCL.H_ADD_TS AS ENDDT

FROM HS.CLM_CLAIM		AS CLM
JOIN        HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON CLM.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
LEFT JOIN HS.H_CAU_CLM_AUD 	AS CL	ON CLM.CLM_ID = CL.H_CAU_CLM_ID AND TRIM(CL.H_CAU_REQ_TO) IN (SELECT TRIM(CLM_QUEUE) FROM BPAAS.CLM_QUEUE_OWNER WHERE CLM_QUEUE_OWNER = 'CLIENT' WITH UR) AND CL.H_TYPE_IND != 'D' AND CL.H_CAU_TYPE = 'REV'
LEFT JOIN HS.H_CAU_CLM_AUD 	AS NCL 	ON CL.H_CAU_CLM_ID = NCL.H_CAU_CLM_ID AND (TRIM(NCL.H_CAU_REQ_TO) IN (SELECT TRIM(CLM_QUEUE) FROM BPAAS.CLM_QUEUE_OWNER WHERE CLM_QUEUE_OWNER = 'CLIENT' WITH UR)) 
							AND NCL.H_CAU_TYPE = 'REV' AND NCL.H_TYPE_IND IN ('D')
							AND CL.H_CAU_ADD_TS = NCL.H_CAU_ADD_TS
WITH UR
),

CLIENT_AGE2 AS (
SELECT DISTINCT A1.CLM_ID,
DATE(A1.STARTDT) AS STARTUP,
MAX(DATE(A2.ENDDT)) AS ENDUP

FROM CLIENT_AGE1 AS A1
LEFT JOIN CLIENT_AGE1 AS A2 ON A1.CLM_ID = A2.CLM_ID AND A1.ENDDT BETWEEN A2.STARTDT AND A2.ENDDT
 
GROUP BY A1.CLM_ID, A1.STARTDT),

CLIENT_AGE AS (
SELECT DISTINCT A1.CLM_ID,
MIN(DATE(A1.STARTUP)) AS STARTUP,
A2.ENDUP AS ENDUP

FROM CLIENT_AGE2 AS A1
LEFT JOIN CLIENT_AGE2 AS A2 ON A1.CLM_ID = A2.CLM_ID AND A1.ENDUP = A2.ENDUP
 
GROUP BY A1.CLM_ID, A2.ENDUP
)

SELECT 
CLM_ID AS CLAIM_ID,
SUM(DAYS(NVL(ENDUP,CURRENT_DATE)) - DAYS(NVL(STARTUP,CURRENT_DATE))) AS CLIENT_AGE
FROM CLIENT_AGE 
GROUP BY CLM_ID
